On May 1, 2019, the global region resource GUIDs for Azure Event Hubs will break out into new US Government region resource GUIDs. The Basic Throughput Unit, Capture, Basic Ingress Events, and Standard Throughput Unit meters will break out into US Gov, US Gov Arizona, US Gov Texas, and US DoD regions. The resource GUIDs and names displayed in your billing will be affected. See the following table for details.
